protocol_version.description: Protocol version understood by the five-command core.

status.description: Packet is complete enough for a fresh review context.

instruction.description: Reviewer instructions; review must not reuse generation rationale.

project_memory.description: Source/target locale, declared sources, style, preserve rules, translation memory, and confirmed decisions.

glossary.description: Canonical concept-centered Glossary supplied for terminology checks.

deterministic_check.description: Latest deterministic check result, or null when review is prepared before check evidence exists.

source_target_mapping.description: Explicit source-to-target pairing in scan order; reviewers must use this mapping when reading files.

files.description: Per-file aligned source and target segments for independent language review.

review_result_format.description: Expected JSON shape from the independent reviewer: auto-cleared checks go in review_items; only real issues go in findings.
